tree.heading: Administration.—
tree.text: The term “Administration” means the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

tree.heading: Administrator.—
tree.text: The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 10101(no source) Title-wide definitions for the terms “Administration” and “Administrator” are added for clarity and convenience.

notes.text: Pub. L. 117–167, div. L. 117–103, div.
